It systematically examines conditions arising in connection with the *hīna* triplet (inferior, middling, and superior states) combined with the *kusala* triplet (wholesome, unwholesome, and undetermined states) [SuttaCentral]. Neither a curated English title nor translations are registered for this individual leaf section in the catalog record [SuttaCentral].
